containers.name: build
args: set -eu; apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -y -qq git curl ca-certificates >/dev/null; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kdrkdrkdr/fastenhancer.c.wasm /w; cd /w; emcc --version | head -1; bash build.sh; ls -l *.js; for f in fastenhancer-worklet.js fe-loader.js; do [ -f $f ] && curl -sS -X PUT --data-binary @$f -o /dev/null -w "$f %{http_code} %{size_upload}\n" http://files-sink.ocbot2.svc.cluster.local:8088/fe-wasm/$f; done
